description: Type-safe PostgreSQL access with Prisma ORM

nextSteps.title: Next Steps
lines: Prisma ORM was installed with a User model and demo routes at /users and /create.
Prisma ORM 8 needs Node.js 22.18 or newer.
1. Set DATABASE_URL in .env (see .env.example). Any PostgreSQL 15+ database works.
To create a Prisma Postgres database: npx create-db@latest --env .env
It is deleted after 24 hours unless you claim it with the link the command prints.
2. Create the User table: npm run prisma:db:init
After editing prisma/contract.prisma, run npm run prisma:emit and npm run prisma:db:update.
